{{Short description|Nigerian mathematician}}
'''Adegoke Olubummo''' was a Nigerian academic and [[mathematician]]. He is known for being the first Nigerian professor in mathematics.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Adegoke Olubummo - Biography|url=https://mathshistory.st-andrews.ac.uk/Biographies/Olubummo_Adegoke/|access-date=2021-09-15|website=Maths History|language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|date=2014-04-24|title=Sambo lauds UI's decision to name centre after first math professor|url=https://www.vanguardngr.com/2014/04/sambo-lauds-uis-decision-name-centre-first-math-professor/|location=Lagos, Nigeria|access-date=2021-09-15|newspaper=[[Vanguard (Nigeria)|Vanguard]]|language=en-US}}</ref>

== Early life and education ==
Adegoke attended Ifaki Methodist school and finished in 1937. In 1938, he continued to [[Wesley College, Ibadan|Wesley College]] in Ibadan. He got his a B.A. from [[Fourah Bay College]] in [[Sierra Leone]].<ref name=":0" />

In 1952, he earned his M.A. in Mathematics and Ph.D. in 1955 from King's College, [[Durham University|University of Durham]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|title=Adegoke Olubummo, Mathematician of the African Diaspora|url=http://www.math.buffalo.edu/mad/PEEPS/olubummo_adegoke.html|access-date=2021-09-15|website=www.math.buffalo.edu}}</ref>

He began lecturing in the mathematics department at the University College, Ibadan in 1955 and became a full professor in 1964. He was the head of the Department of Mathematics at the [[University of Ibadan]] for many years. He became the Dean of the Faculty of Science of [[Ondo State University]] after retiring from the University of Ibadan in 1985.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Adegoke Olubummo - The Mathematics Genealogy Project|url=https://www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu/id.php?id=42199|access-date=2021-09-15|website=www.genealogy.math.ndsu.nodak.edu}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Adegoke has three children who are mathematicians. He is the father to the mathematician [[Yewande Olubummo]].<ref>{{Cite news|date=2018-08-20|title=3 reasons many students find Mathematics difficult|url=https://www.pulse.ng/communities/student/the-fear-of-maths-3-reasons-many-students-find-mathematics-difficult/ez8zbrr|access-date=2021-09-15|newspaper=[[Pulse Nigeria]]|language=en}}</ref>
